about.description:
Jupyter AI Lite brings AI chat and code completions to JupyterLab,
Notebook 7 and JupyterLite, running entirely in the browser without a
server-side AI backend. It is the successor of jupyterlite-ai.

- jupyter-ai-agent-lite: the building blocks of in-browser AI personas
  (tools, skills, settings and sign-in helpers)
- jupyternaut-lite: the Jupyternaut persona (chat and code completions)
- jupyter-ai-lite: a meta-package that installs the full experience

name: jupyter-ai-agent-lite
raw_meta_yaml:
schema_version: 1

context:
  version: "0.21.0"

recipe:
  name: jupyter-ai-lite
  version: ${{ version }}

build:
  number: 0
  noarch: python

outputs:
  - package:
      name: jupyter-ai-agent-lite
    source:
      url: https://pypi.org/packages/source/j/jupyter-ai-agent-lite/jupyter_ai_agent_lite-${{ version }}.tar.gz
      sha256: bd697d919ecb1ff90bd2b1fdb46c70f312ed0f19308e2dac92c046473564aeef
    build:
      noarch: python
      script: ${{ PYTHON }} -m pip install . -vv --no-deps --no-build-isolation
    requirements:
      host:
        - python ${{ python_min }}.*
        - hatchling >=1.5.0
        - hatch-jupyter-builder >=0.5
        - jupyter-builder >=1.2.2
        - pip
      run:
        - python >=${{ python_min }}
        - jupyterlab-ai-commands >=0.4.0,<0.5
    tests:
      - python:
          python_version:
            - ${{ python_min }}.*
            - "*"
          pip_check: true
          imports: jupyter_ai_agent_lite
      - package_contents:
          files:
            - share/jupyter/labextensions/@jupyter-ai/agent-lite/package.json
      - script:
          - jupyter labextension list 2>&1 | rg -ie "@jupyter-ai/agent-lite.*OK"
        requirements:
          run:
            - python ${{ python_min }}.*
            - jupyterlab >=4.5.0,<5
            - ripgrep
    about:
      summary: "The building blocks of in-browser AI personas for Jupyter AI: tools, skills, settings and sign-in helpers"

  - package:
      name: jupyternaut-lite
    source:
      url: https://pypi.org/packages/source/j/jupyternaut-lite/jupyternaut_lite-${{ version }}.tar.gz
      sha256: 135a4d4e8240ef523d9014dc27bc2a053268ec61f5cfac528cf471c893126066
    build:
      noarch: python
      script: ${{ PYTHON }} -m pip install . -vv --no-deps --no-build-isolation
    requirements:
      host:
        - python ${{ python_min }}.*
        - hatchling >=1.5.0
        - hatch-jupyter-builder >=0.5
        - jupyter-builder >=1.2.2
        - pip
      run:
        - python >=${{ python_min }}
        - ${{ pin_subpackage("jupyter-ai-agent-lite", exact=True) }}
        - jupyter-ai-persona-manager >=0.3.0a0,<0.4
        - jupyter-chat-components >=0.7.0,<0.8
        - jupyter-mcp-manager >=0.2.0,<0.3
        - jupyter-secrets-manager >=0.5,<0.6
        - jupyterlab-ai-commands >=0.4.0,<0.5
        - jupyterlab-chat >=0.25.2,<0.26
    tests:
      - python:
          python_version:
            - ${{ python_min }}.*
            - "*"
          pip_check: true
          imports: jupyternaut_lite
      - package_contents:
          files:
            - share/jupyter/labextensions/@jupyter-ai/jupyternaut-lite/package.json
      - script:
          - jupyter labextension list 2>&1 | rg -ie "@jupyter-ai/jupyternaut-lite.*OK"
        requirements:
          run:
            - python ${{ python_min }}.*
            - jupyterlab >=4.5.0,<5
            - ripgrep
    about:
      summary: "The Jupyternaut persona for JupyterLab and JupyterLite: AI chat and code completions in the browser"

  - package:
      name: jupyter-ai-lite
    source:
      url: https://pypi.org/packages/source/j/jupyter-ai-lite/jupyter_ai_lite-${{ version }}.tar.gz
      sha256: 5015bead1984f160070e4b785af82f04d37e47cc904eba0688244212395efbfd
    build:
      noarch: python
      script: ${{ PYTHON }} -m pip install . -vv --no-deps --no-build-isolation
    requirements:
      host:
        - python ${{ python_min }}.*
        - hatchling >=1.5.0
        - pip
      run:
        - python >=${{ python_min }}
        - ${{ pin_subpackage("jupyternaut-lite", exact=True) }}
    tests:
      - python:
          python_version:
            - ${{ python_min }}.*
            - "*"
          pip_check: true
          imports: jupyter_ai_lite
      - script:
          - jupyter labextension list 2>&1 | rg -ie "@jupyter-ai/agent-lite.*OK"
          - jupyter labextension list 2>&1 | rg -ie "@jupyter-ai/jupyternaut-lite.*OK"
        requirements:
          run:
            - python ${{ python_min }}.*
            - jupyterlab >=4.5.0,<5
            - ripgrep
    about:
      summary: Browser-based AI code completions and chat for JupyterLab, Notebook 7 and JupyterLite (meta-package)

about:
  homepage: https://github.com/jupyterlab/jupyter-ai-lite
  repository: https://github.com/jupyterlab/jupyter-ai-lite
  documentation: https://jupyter-ai-lite.readthedocs.io/
  summary: Browser-based AI code completions and chat for JupyterLab, Notebook 7 and JupyterLite
  description: |
    Jupyter AI Lite brings AI chat and code completions to JupyterLab,
    Notebook 7 and JupyterLite, running entirely in the browser without a
    server-side AI backend. It is the successor of jupyterlite-ai.

    - jupyter-ai-agent-lite: the building blocks of in-browser AI personas
      (tools, skills, settings and sign-in helpers)
    - jupyternaut-lite: the Jupyternaut persona (chat and code completions)
    - jupyter-ai-lite: a meta-package that installs the full experience
  license: BSD-3-Clause
  license_file: LICENSE

extra:
  feedstock-name: jupyter-ai-lite
  recipe-maintainers:
    - brichet
    - jtpio
    - krassowski
